correctness.rationale: Using D=a|w|_0/b-|w|_1, a 1-run with starting discrepancy d>=0 has length floor(d)+1 and final discrepancy in [-1,0). After a completed earlier run, a subsequent zero-run of length ell gives d=delta+(a/b)ell. For ell<=b-1 the next 1-run is shorter than a+1; ell=b gives length exactly a; ell>=b+1 gives at least a+2. A first run has length a+1 only after exactly b initial zeros. Hence the marker exists at the beginning but never later; open-cylinder factor language and nonrecurrence prove nontransitivity. Direct independent finite prefix enumeration at several coprime pairs corroborates, but does not prove, the all-rational claim.
